sblgBreadcrumbTrailStyleClass.description: Assigns a styling class to the breadcrumb trail

egSBLBreadcrumbDividerStyleClass.description: Assigns a divider styling class such as sbl-breadcrumb-pipe or sbl-breadcrumb-arrow

egSBLPropertySearchPatternByNamespace.description: An array of search patterns on a per-namespace basis; if no pattern is declared for a namespace then the search is disabled for it

egSBLTryToFindClosestDescendant.description: SBL will try to find the closest descendant (this does not work for subpages due to missing annotation information)

egSBLUseSubpageFinderFallback.description: SBL will try to match a hierarchy based on the Foo/Bar/Baz subpage notation when a property search returns empty results

egSBLPageTitleToHideSubpageParent.description: SBL will try to hide the parent part of a subpage title from display when a corresponding namespace entry is found in the wgNamespacesWithSubpages setting

egSBLEnabledSubpageParentAnnotation.description: Supports the auto-generation of Has parent page annotations for subpages

egSBLDisableTranslationSubpageAnnotation.description: Disables the annotation for a subpage when it is identified as a translation page
